name: Cloth
description: Flexible ballistic cloth worn as a full body suit. Standard issue for many military and paramilitary organisations.

name: Mesh
description: Armour made of interlocking metal or ceramic plates over a flexible backing.

name: Flak Jacket
description: Armoured jacket designed to protect against shrapnel and low-velocity projectiles.

name: Flak Pants
description: Armoured trousers providing protection to the lower body.

name: Combat Armour
description: Full body powered combat armour with integrated life support and enhanced strength servos. Requires the Combat Armour skill to use effectively.

name: Vacc Suit
description: Standard vacuum suit for operation in hard vacuum and hostile environments. Provides life support and basic radiation protection.

name: Battle Dress
description: The ultimate personal armour. A full exoskeleton with advanced weapons integration, sensor suites, and heavy radiation shielding. Requires Battle Dress skill.

name: Hostile Environment Vacc Suit
description: Heavy-duty vacc suit built for extreme environments including high radiation zones and corrosive atmospheres.

name: Shield
description: A personal energy shield that provides additional protection against incoming attacks.

name: Reflec
description: Reflec armour provides no protection against conventional attacks, but offers protection 14 against laser weapons.

name: Ablat
description: Ablative armour designed to degrade under fire, providing protection by shedding layers of material.

name: Ballistic Cloth
description: Lightweight cloth armour offering basic protection against low-velocity projectiles.

name: Combat Environment Suit
description: Hybrid armour combining combat protection with environment sealing for vacuum operations.

name: Stealth Suit
description: Advanced armour designed to reduce the wearer's signature across multiple sensor spectra.
